CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_packing_lists" (
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "confirmedBy" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "packageCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "packingNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productionOrderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "salesOrderId" uuid,
  "shipmentId" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "totalQuantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_lists_status_e383a8e3" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED', 'SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_lists_totals_94854e8d" CHECK ("totalQuantity" > 0 AND "packageCount" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_packing_packages" (
  "dimensions" text,
  "grossWeight" numeric,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "marks" text,
  "netWeight" numeric,
  "packageNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "packageType" text NOT NULL,
  "packingListId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_packages_quantity_positive_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_packages_weights_11116c74" CHECK (("netWeight" IS NULL OR "netWeight" >= 0) AND ("grossWeight" IS NULL OR "grossWeight" >= 0))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_quality_inspections" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "decidedBy" uuid,
  "decisionNote" text,
  "defects" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectedQuantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "inspectionNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectionType" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectorName" text,
  "locationId" uuid,
  "passedQuantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productionOrderId" uuid,
  "rejectedQuantity" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "remarks" text,
  "reworkQuantity" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "sampleSize" int4,
  "stageKey" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_quality_inspections_balance_722a9d01" CHECK ("inspectedQuantity" = "passedQuantity" + "reworkQuantity" + "rejectedQuantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_quality_inspections_quantities_ea110972" CHECK ("inspectedQuantity" > 0 AND "passedQuantity" >= 0 AND "reworkQuantity" >= 0 AND "rejectedQuantity" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_quality_inspections_status_d2448e5d" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'APPROVED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_quality_inspections_type_40a4b6a4" CHECK ("inspectionType" IN ('INCOMING', 'IN_PROCESS', 'FINAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_shipment_lines" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "packingListId" uuid,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "salesOrderLineId" uuid,
  "shipmentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_shipment_lines_quantity_positive_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_shipments" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "deliveredBy" uuid,
  "deliveryAddress" text,
  "deliveryNote" text,
  "dispatchedAt" timestamptz,
  "dispatchedBy" uuid,
  "driverName" text,
  "driverPhone" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "receivedBy" text,
  "salesOrderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shipmentNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "trackingReference" text,
  "transporter" text,
  "vehicleNumber" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_shipments_status_12ca9948" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'DISPATCHED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED'))
)
